name: IDBI Bank Limited
summary: IDBI Bank Limited provides banking and financial solutions to retail and corporate customers in India. It operates through four segments: Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, Treasury Operations, and Other banking operations. The company offers savings, current, and salary accounts, as well as fixed deposits; home, auto, education, mortgage, and personal loans, as well as loans against properties and securities; debit, credit, and prepaid cards; mobile and internet banking; and investment advisory and capital market services. It also provides fund and non-fund-based assistance; packing credit to exporters; receivable buyout with recourse; channel financing for dealers of corporates; …
